core_meaning.short_meaning: Truth, reality, right, that which is due
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haq is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Truth, reality, right, that which is due”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haq corresponds to the Arabic form حق (Arabic root ح ق ق (ḥ-q-q); حَقّ (Ḥaqq)). Its core sense is truth, reality, right. Haq is Arabic حَقّ (Ḥaqq) 'truth, reality, right, that which is due', from the root ح ق ق (ḥ-q-q). It is a divine name and the word appears in the Qur'an. The source gloss 'truth' is correct. Same name as haqq.
